verdict.rationale: Raygun supports selecting and exporting multiple/all error groups (raygun-docs-9) and bulk 'ignore' rules applying conditions across error groups (raygun-docs-11, raygun-docs-34), which are bulk-style operations, plus an MCP server exists for programmatic/agent access (raygun-probe-3). However there's no documented bulk resolve/delete/tag/assign API for arbitrary large-scale item sets, and no evidence of a general-purpose bulk API endpoint. missing for 10: documented bulk resolve/delete/assign operations, a general bulk API/endpoint beyond export/ignore, and independent confirmation of bulk-scale reliability.
